row_materialization.scenario_template: Complete {change}:{task_id} and verify its authoritative acceptance statement.

evidence_layers.unit: Focused owning-logic or artifact-policy test selected exactly once.
evidence_layers.integration: Changed crate, database, filesystem, process, or service boundary.
evidence_layers.e2e: Changed CLI, MCP, installer, or other public workflow.
evidence_layers.platform: Every affected supported operating-system or packaging boundary.
evidence_layers.property: Generated invariants for identities, ordering, bounds, or serialization.
evidence_layers.fuzz: Malformed or adversarial input at parser, migration, path, or protocol boundaries.
evidence_layers.benchmark: Pinned comparative evidence for performance, resource, accuracy, or agent claims.
evidence_layers.packaged_smoke: Actually installed release artifact exercised through real CLI and stdio MCP against project-local SQLite populated from a small real repository.
